properties.title: Tornado Warning issued October 25 at 10:46PM MDT until October 25 at 11:15PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
TOREPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Northwestern Hudspeth County in western Texas...

* Until 1115 PM MDT.

* At 1045 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a
tornado was located 4 miles south of Desert Haven, moving east at
20 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This tornadic thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
northwestern Hudspeth County.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in New

be flooded. Further rises will impact Interstate 25 traffic.

observations available thereafter.
- Bankfull stage is 18.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum known river stage in the 24 hours
ending at 3:00 PM MDT Sunday was 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 24.2 feet
just after midnight tonight. It will then fall below flood stage
early Thursday morning.
- Flood stage is 19.5 feet.
- Flood History...No available flood history.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Persistent gusty northeast winds are causing river levels to rise on
the St Johns at Astor, currently in Moderate Flood Stage. The river
is forecast to continue to climb slowly through Moderate Flood Stage
early this week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

or near Wildhog, Bonnet and Snail roads become inaccessible with
several inches of water inside homes along the river and canals.
Docks at Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely
submerged. Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with
yards completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads
flooded in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on
Juno Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 3.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Sunday was 3.6 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 3.8 feet
tomorrow evening.

through flooded areas.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall which occurred over
the last couple of days is expected or ongoing.

* WHERE...Northeastern Conejos County in south central Colorado...
Southwestern Alamosa County in southeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 900 AM MDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding will occur in low-lying and flood-prone
locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 852 AM MDT, flooding was occurring along the Rio Grande River
in low lying and agricultural areas. This high water is due to
all of the heavy rain which occurred over the last couple of
days.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include low lying
areas in parts of Alamosa and parts of Conejos counties.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

deaths occur in vehicles.
